frozen_journeys.description: An authenticated site-33 learner enters from the public Deep Learning Specialization, selects the one explicitly inferred USD 49.00 plan, passes through a memory-only synthetic payment form, reviews server-owned totals, and submits an opaque approved local-sandbox scenario plus idempotency key. Approval consumption, immutable order creation, and paid enrollment transition commit in one caller-owned site SQLite transaction.

An authenticated site-33 learner submits an opaque declined or retryable local-sandbox scenario and receives a safe result with retry and collection navigation; no successful order or paid enrollment is created.

The authenticated owner can view durable order history and detail, atomically cancel the paid order and enrollment while retaining the immutable snapshot, and return to the Deep Learning collection; foreign owners see no record.

payment_contract.amount_source: One server-owned inferred Deep Learning plan snapshot: integer subtotal 4900 minor units, tax 0, and total 4900 in USD. The client cannot supply or change course, plan, amount, tax, total, currency, owner, flow, or fingerprint at final submit.
payment_contract.owner: The currently authenticated site-33 learner subject owns the server-stored opaque checkout draft, generated payment flow, order snapshot, and paid enrollment; unknown and foreign records are not disclosed.
payment_contract.fingerprint: Frozen canonical SHA-256 of the server-owned course id, plan id and label, inferred-pricing evidence label, integer subtotal/tax/total, and USD currency. Final submit revalidates the current owner, amount, currency, and fingerprint.
payment_contract.final_commit: SitePayments.consume_approval(), INSERT coursera_orders, and the paid coursera_enrollments upsert execute on the same caller-owned site-bound SQLite connection and transaction; any failure rolls back approval consumption, order creation, and enrollment transition together.

proof_obligations: The attempt endpoint accepts exactly one opaque configured sandbox scenario id and one idempotency key; missing, duplicate, extra, or payment-credential-looking fields are rejected.
Synthetic card number, expiry, and security-code browser controls have no submitted name and no value is persisted, logged, or sent to any origin.
Only sandbox-approved, sandbox-declined, and sandbox-retry are accepted, and local-sandbox is the only configured adapter across every deployment profile.
Approved payment consumption, the immutable USD 49.00 order snapshot, and paid enrollment transition commit or roll back together in one site-bound SQLite transaction.
Declined and retryable attempts create no successful order or paid enrollment, while a fresh valid attempt remains possible.
Stale draft or generated-flow facts, stale fingerprint, invalid plan, malformed idempotency, foreign owner, conflicting key reuse, and duplicate approval consumption are rejected.
Order history and cancellation remain owner-scoped and durable across service restart; cancellation retains the order snapshot and atomically cancels the paid enrollment.
Reset clears checkout drafts, generated payment state, orders, and paid enrollment state and restores the deterministic site-33 seeds.
Stripe test, live payment credentials, provider calls, real payment data, external mail, and production side effects remain unavailable.
